definition_zh: 将对称正定矩阵分解为三角因子乘积的方法。
usage_overview: 用于位移方程的数值求解：当等效刚度矩阵满足对称正定条件时，将其分解为三角因子，再利用分解结果求得位移。

P091.title: Further research of multi-scale assemble and matrix reassemble method for efficient analysis of railway track–substructure system subjected to a moving train
P091.authors: L Xu, L Wu, Z Li, B Peng, T Lu, Z Yu

complete_examples.text: The matrix reassembling tactic is based on the multi-scale assemble method, through which the finite element matrix bandwidth is greatly narrowed, and the Cholesky factorization, iterative and multi-time-step solution have been introduced to efficiently obtain the train, track and substructure responses.

By properly utilization of the Cholesky factorization, iterative and multi-time-step solution, the efficiency of train–track–subgrade interaction analysis can be promoted significantly without loss of accuracy.
